name: EVM-style accounts (Ethereum and the chains that reuse its address format)
checksum_algorithm: optional EIP-55 mixed-case checksum (Keccak-256 of the lower-case hex)
case_rules: all lower case or all upper case letters: no checksum asserted; mixed case: must equal the EIP-55 capitalisation; EIP-1191 defines a different capitalisation for some chains

name: Bitcoin
alphabet: Base58 (Bitcoin alphabet) for legacy forms; Bech32 for segwit forms
lengths: 25-byte Base58Check payload (26-35 characters); Bech32 up to 90 characters
prefixes: version 0x00 (1...) and 0x05 (3...); HRP bc, witness version 0 (Bech32) or 1-16 (Bech32m)
case_rules: Base58 case sensitive; Bech32 all lower or all upper case, never mixed

name: Litecoin
alphabet: Base58 for legacy forms; Bech32 for segwit forms
lengths: 25-byte Base58Check payload; Bech32 up to 90 characters
case_rules: Base58 case sensitive; Bech32 all lower or all upper case

name: Bitcoin Cash
alphabet: CashAddr base32 (the Bech32 alphabet); Base58 for the legacy form
lengths: CashAddr: 42 characters after the prefix for a 20-byte hash, up to 102 for 64 bytes; legacy: 25-byte payload
prefixes: CashAddr prefix bitcoincash (may be omitted), type 0 (q...) and 1 (p...); legacy versions 0x00 and 0x05
checksum_algorithm: CashAddr BCH code (40 bits); Base58Check for the legacy form
case_rules: CashAddr all lower or all upper case, never mixed; legacy case sensitive

name: Zcash (transparent forms)
case_rules: Base58 case sensitive; tex all lower or all upper case
memo_notes: transparent addresses carry no memo; shielded outputs have an encrypted memo field (no shielded vectors in this release)

name: Solana
lengths: 32 to 44 characters; decodes to exactly 32 bytes

name: TRON
checksum_algorithm: Base58Check (double SHA-256); none for the hex form
case_rules: Base58 case sensitive; hex form: either case (the documentation prints both)

name: NEAR
alphabet: lower-case letters, digits, and the separators . - _
prefixes: none; implicit accounts are 64 hex digits, Ethereum-like 0x + 40 hex, deterministic 0s + 40 hex, universal 0u + 52 characters (all satisfy the same grammar)
memo_notes: no address-level memo; NEP-141 fungible-token transfers take an optional memo argument and custodial deposit services may require one

name: TON
alphabet: user-friendly: base64 or base64url; raw: workchain, colon, 64 hex digits
lengths: user-friendly: 48 characters (36 bytes); raw: 64 hex digits after the colon
prefixes: flags 0x11 (E...) bounceable, 0x51 (U...) non-bounceable, +0x80 testnet-only (k..., 0...); workchain 0 or -1
checksum_algorithm: CRC16-XMODEM (big-endian) for the user-friendly form; none for raw
case_rules: base64 case sensitive; raw hex either case
memo_notes: transfer messages can carry a plaintext comment; deposit services commonly use it as a tag

name: XRP Ledger
checksum_algorithm: Base58Check with the XRPL alphabet (double SHA-256)
memo_notes: 32-bit unsigned destination tag, carried in the transaction or packed into an X-address

name: Stellar
alphabet: RFC 4648 base32, upper case, no padding
lengths: G and C: 56 characters; M: 69 characters
checksum_algorithm: CRC16-XMODEM (little-endian) over version byte and payload
memo_notes: transactions carry a memo; custodial deposits commonly require one (SEP-29); an M address embeds a 64-bit id
